changelog:
Initial release of "十万个为什么 · 儿童科普问答" skill.

- Answers kids' science questions with accurate, age-appropriate, structured explanations.
- Generates one child-safe AI illustration (ImageGen) per answer section; images are paired with their respective text.
- Outputs a typeset, illustrated HTML page in a picture-book style.
- Designed for questions about natural phenomena, animals, space, technology, and daily life, triggered by "why" (为什么) or specific children's science requests.
- Built-in sharing options: recommends saving illustrated pages to the content library, with alternatives for IMA and Tencent Docs.
- Safety and age-appropriate communication are enforced; excludes unsafe experiments, medical advice, or inappropriate content.
summary: Children's popular-science Q&A skill with per-section AI illustrations and a typeset illustrated page (Ten Thousand Whys / 十万个为什么). Answers kids' curiosity questions with accurate, age-appropriate structured explanations, generates ONE child-safe AI picture (ImageGen) per answer section, pairs each
